general_information.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
general_information.Description: - Main objective: This course provides an overview of the operations of a mid-size full-service hotel, from lodging to food and beverage, marketing and sales, human resources,... The focus of this course will be on explaining the functions of each department in a hotel, the inter-relationships among them, and management skills development. This course offers up-to-date information of multiple aspects in hotel operations, and essential insights for future hotel managers. -Description: Hotel operational management introduces an overview of thel operation and organization of a midsize hotel. The course focuses on the front office, housekeeping, F&B and how they relate to each other in order to provide excellent service to customers. Other departments are also explained to provide a full understanding of the organization of a hotel. Students are to practice their analyzing and problem solving skills with up-to-date real life example and current trends. -Teaching method: lecture, discussion, demonstration, roleplay, project based learning, group work
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Promptly access to the FU CMS at http://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Describe functions of different departments of a hotel and their interrelationships among them.
Illustrate the basic jobs of each department in a hotel.
Solve the problems in common hotel operation situations
Categorize hotels by market segmentations: level of service, location, …
Apply management skills in practical hotel operation case study
Identify the role of service quality and service performance in hotel management
Design an overall plan of a mid-size full-service hotel with distinctive marketing ideas
Explain the pricing concepts in hotels and revenue management theories
Solve accounting problems for practical case study
Respect ethics and professional standards of behavior in the hospitality industry

constructive_questions.Name: CT1.1
constructive_questions.Details: What are the analyses of segments in the tourism industry and the marketing orientation for each segment? What is the difference in the structure of small and large hotels?

constructive_questions.Name: CT1.2
constructive_questions.Details: What are the types of accommodation in Vietnam? What are the salient features of each type of accommodation associated with types of hotel ownership and management?

constructive_questions.Name: CT1.3
constructive_questions.Details: What standards in Vietnam are used to rate or evaluate hotels? How does it represent the criteria and requirements?

constructive_questions.Name: ĐN1.4
constructive_questions.Details: How many aspects affect customer service? Why are service culture and manager roles so important in guest service?

constructive_questions.Name: CT2.1
constructive_questions.Details: What are the components of Quality in the Hospitality Industry (Name of each component and analysis)? What are the special features of service quality?

constructive_questions.Name: CT2.2
constructive_questions.Details: What is IHG's competitive advantage over the competition? (Take the Intercontinental Da Nang Peninsula as a specific example)

constructive_questions.Name: CT2.3
constructive_questions.Details: How do moments of Truth relate to service? (Analyze Pullman Hotel as an example).

constructive_questions.Name: CT2.4
constructive_questions.Details: Why is internal training so important in hotels?

constructive_questions.Name: CT2.5
constructive_questions.Details: Based on job search sites such as hoteljob, CareerBuilder, .. and 5-star hotel personnel structure, what are the roles and responsibilities of the managers in each department in the hotel?

constructive_questions.Details: Corporate Culture in the hotel and GM of the hotel, How are they related?

constructive_questions.Name: CT3.3
constructive_questions.Details: What strategies are there to improve motivation? Choose any 2 strategies to analyze and evaluate their importance?

constructive_questions.Name: CT3.4
constructive_questions.Details: Should GM be manager or leader? Why?

constructive_questions.Name: CT3.5
constructive_questions.Details: What is the role of Human resources in the hotel?

constructive_questions.Name: CT4.2
constructive_questions.Details: What factors in the hotel environment affect the human resources of the industry?

constructive_questions.Name: CT4.3

constructive_questions.Name: CT4.4
constructive_questions.Details: As an HR, what should you do to have an employee retention plan?
